name: @starci/seed
description: The data standard of a StarCi project in one package: the two kinds of seed, the standard seed (loaded once by the bring-up) and the backup seed (written by the scheduled job, brought back by a sync). The ports (store and driver adapters, one export to several copies, the copy contract and the line protocol), in-memory references with the store and driver contract suites under ./testing, a git driver (sealed by purpose with sops and age) under ./git, and the postgres store (the whole relational database as deterministic per-table rows) under ./postgres.
author: starci183

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive: true, force: true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('dist', {recursive: true}).filter((n) => n.endsWith('.d.ts'))) fs.writeFileSync('dist/' + f, fs.readFileSync('dist/' + f, 'utf8').replace(/((?:from |import\()['\x22]\.\.?\/[^'\x22]+)\.ts(['\x22])/g, (all, head, quote) => head + '.js' + quote))"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="src/**/*.ts" --test-coverage-exclude="src/**/*.spec.ts" --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 "src/**/*.spec.ts"
